items.current: Confidentiality is the foundation of how we work. Every engagement is covered by strict confidentiality, NDAs on request, least-privilege access, and end-to-end encryption. We never reuse or train shared models on your data.
items.proposed: We encrypt your data, limit who can reach it, and use it only for your work. A nondisclosure agreement is available on request.

items.current: Do you work with startups and small companies, or only large enterprises?

items.current: Both. We work with startups and mid-size companies through to large enterprises - every engagement is scoped to fit your needs and budget.
items.proposed: We accept projects from companies of any size. Scope, schedule, and cost are set per project in the written plan.
items.note: "We take work from" sat below the register of the rest of the page. The old answer claimed an existing client base across three size segments.

items.current: It depends on scope, which we define together before any commitment. The first conversation is always free, with no obligation.

items.proposed: What kinds of work do you take on?

items.note: New answer. Examples of work the four service areas cover, not a claim of completed engagements.
